source.title: wow-auction README — Serevite item rank example (cross-checked with live GoldCap)
source.author: t-mart

notes: Name-first primary prospecting/milling searches across Reddit, Wowhead and WoW-Professions found only existing original cohorts and source-independent guide priors; no new completed-operation material-hit counts or zero-inclusive 0-N histograms. Two independent sources agree Serevite 190395=R1, 190396=R2, 190394=R3, but SaddlebagExchange currently labels 190396 Quality 3; preserve conflict for Master. GoldCap says Draconium 189143=R1, 188658=R2 and Khaz'gorite 190312/190313/190314=R1/R2/R3. These rank labels are reference/identity evidence, NOT processing-study data; original output quantities, finished casts, Resourcefulness refunds and histograms remain unknown.
lookingFor: Previously unindexed original completed Dragonflight Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage/Hochenblume milling source table with actual casts, output IDs, material hits/zeros/0-N histograms; independently verify ore-to-rank IDs.
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy: named 'Draconium Ore' / 'Serevite Ore' original prospect samples; 10i63zb already indexed, no new per-output 0/1/2+ event ledger.
Reddit r/woweconomy: named 'Khaz’gorite Ore' 100 R2 original prospect, 10h6ccx; previously queued and indexed as one 20-prospect zero-diamond cohort.

Reddit r/woweconomy: named 'Hochenblume' 10,500 original herb milling study 10me1e7; previously indexed, resourcefulness recasts prevent recovering actual completed cast count from nominal 1,500/9,000 herbs.
Wowhead original item comments: named 'Prismatic Ore' 194545; TheChisel, Hotfor, Zuhla and superbondez original source reports all already represented; no new per-material hit/zero histogram.
Wowhead original item comments: named 'Illimited Diamond' 192869; Bugy averages and neoslayyer rank reports previously indexed, no independent 0-N completed-operation log.
Wowhead original item comments: named 'Blazing Pigment' 198418; Aary sample already indexed, lacks actual completed milling casts and per-output hit counts.
WoW-Professions Dragon Isles Inscription guide: Bubble Poppy / Saxifrage milling 5 herbs per recipe and stated 2-5 pigment output is guide reference, not measured random outcome histogram.
GoldCap live item identity: Serevite 190395 R1, 190396 R2, 190394 R3; Draconium 189143 R1 and 188658 R2; Khaz’gorite 190312 R1, 190313 R2, 190314 R3. Identity only, not yield evidence.

Independent public GitHub README t-mart/wow-auction explicitly lists Serevite 190395 R1, 190396 R2, 190394 R3, corroborating GoldCap; third-party data still warrants Master review for current runtime.
SaddlebagExchange page labels Serevite ID 190396 'Quality 3', contradicting the two sources above; unresolved cross-site identity inconsistency, do not silently select it as the only authority.
